newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel steady, buying interest quickens.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel steady, buying interest quickens.

text.p: Scandinavian demand for dual purpose kerosene enlivened NWE jet fuel on Tuesday but premiums were steady in thin volumes, traders said.
"Demand is certainly healthier than supply," a barge trader said.
Jan IPE gas oil futures ended trade down $2.50 at $229.50 a tonne after the U.S. heating oil market came under pressure.
Cargo premiums were around Jan IPE +$30/31 cif NWE. Barges were around Jan IPE +$28 fob ARA. Arbitrages to Asia from the Med have closed.
